name: halcyon-weather
description: Halcyon weather — performance-tuned weather app (stale-while-revalidate cache, progressive paint, idle + hover prefetch). Source is JSX; the browser loads precompiled plain JS.

scripts.build: babel src --out-dir docs/src --extensions .jsx --out-file-extension .js && babel tweaks-panel.jsx --out-file docs/tweaks-panel.js
